cards.card_text: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, the one on the rocky ground quickly ___.
cards.verse_text: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
cards.snippet: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.

cards.card_text: Trouble or persecution over the word Growing bored of the same message Finding a new teacher they prefer
cards.verse_text: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
cards.snippet: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

cards.card_text: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, the rocky-ground people fall away slowly over many years.
cards.verse_text: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
cards.snippet: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

cards.card_text: Jesus promises that anyone who leaves home or family or fields for His sake will receive a hundredfold with no persecutions.
cards.verse_text: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
cards.snippet: …and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.

cards.card_text: On that day, a great persecution breaks out against the church in Jerusalem.
cards.verse_text: On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
cards.snippet: On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles…

cards.card_text: A great persecution breaks out against the church in Jerusalem, and a man named Saul is dragging believers off to prison.
cards.verse_text: On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
cards.snippet: On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles…

cards.card_text: A persecution began with Stephen, a believer who was stoned to death (Acts 7:59-60), and the believers scattered.
cards.verse_text: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.
cards.snippet: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch,…

cards.card_text: Then they stir up persecution against Paul and Barnabas.
cards.verse_text: They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
cards.snippet: They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.

cards.card_text: What does the persecution in Pisidian Antioch do to Paul and Barnabas?
cards.verse_text: They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
cards.snippet: They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.

cards.card_text: Now Paul asks the big one: "Who shall separate us from the love of Christ?" Then he names trouble, distress, persecution, famine, nakedness, danger and sword.
cards.verse_text: Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
cards.snippet: Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

cards.card_text: Paul lists trouble, distress, persecution, famine, nakedness, danger and sword.
cards.verse_text: Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
cards.snippet: Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

cards.card_text: That's why, for the sake of Christ, Paul DELIGHTS in weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions and difficulties.
cards.verse_text: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties.
cards.snippet: …sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties.

cards.card_text: Persecution for the cross of Christ A heavy fine from the council Losing their family's inheritance
cards.verse_text: They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
cards.snippet: They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.

cards.card_text: When Paul and his companions were with the Thessalonians, they promised them that faith would keep them from persecution.
cards.verse_text: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
cards.snippet: …we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.

cards.card_text: Paul and his companions are in distress and persecution, but this news about the Thessalonians' faith reassures them.
cards.verse_text: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
cards.snippet: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.

cards.card_text: Persecution and affliction A long famine in the land Quarrels inside the church
cards.verse_text: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
cards.snippet: …churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.

cards.card_text: Then it takes a turn into his persecutions and sufferings.
cards.verse_text: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance, my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.
cards.snippet: …conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance, my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.

cards.card_text: Then Paul says, "What persecutions I endured!" Friend, I think those memories still hurt.
cards.verse_text: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.
cards.snippet: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.

cards.card_text: After all those persecutions in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, how does Paul say it ended?
cards.verse_text: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.
cards.snippet: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.
